apiNamedQueryParameters.description: The record Id of the applicant's Person Account (Account.Id), taken from the Applicant field on the loan application.

ApiNamedQuery.body2: SELECT Id, Name, PersonBirthdate, PersonMailingAddress, (SELECT Loan_Amount_Requested__c, Declared_Annual_Revenue__c, Verified_Annual_Revenue__c, Security_Type__c, Borrower_Type__c FROM Loan_Applications__r) FROM Account WHERE Id = :applicantId
ApiNamedQuery.description: Returns an applicant's profile: personal details plus all related loan applications (loan amount, declared vs verified revenue, security type, borrower type). Use to load the full applicant profile for a loan assessment.
